name: npc_ronin-wanderer-01
customDialogue:
I walked away from every village once.
The road always brings me back here.

name: npc_ronin-sensei-01
customDialogue:
...
The Silent Ronin only nods toward the dojo, then looks back at you.

name: npc_ronin-archivist-01
customDialogue:
Every scroll here was written by someone who chose to stay.
Read carefully. The Ronin never write twice.

name: npc_ronin-strategist-01
customDialogue:
The fortress was built to keep something in, not to keep enemies out.
Few remember that.

spotConfig.label: Inspect the red dust
spotConfig.text: An old root breaks the ground here. Red dust rises from the crack beneath it.

spotConfig.label: Inspect the red dust
spotConfig.text: More red dust, fine as ash, pooled where a root meets the cliff.

spotConfig.label: Inspect the red dust
spotConfig.text: Outside the wall the dust is thicker. It is rising, not falling.

spotConfig.label: Read the old marker
spotConfig.text: Carved in stone: THE RONIN KEEP THE DOOR SHUT. THE DEBT IS PAID IN SILENCE.

spotConfig.label: Look at the mark
spotConfig.text: A small sword mark, scratched low on the stone. It points east.

spotConfig.label: Look at the mark
spotConfig.text: Another sword mark. This one points back toward the bonsai.

spotConfig.label: Look at the mark
spotConfig.text: The last mark is fresh. Whoever made it was here tonight.

spotConfig.label: Sit by the fire
spotConfig.text: The fire crackles. Somewhere in the dark, someone hums an old Ronin song.

spotConfig.label: Look at the trunk
spotConfig.text: Pressed into the bonsai trunk, a red handprint. The bark around it is still warm.

spotConfig.label: Wait in silence
spotConfig.text: Thirty breaths of silence. Somewhere behind you, a Ronin nods.

spotConfig.label: Touch the stone
spotConfig.text: Behind the dojo the fortress wall is not a wall. It is a door, sealed with the red hand.
In the fog the causeway seems endless, and for a moment you hear footsteps that are not yours.

spotConfig.label: Light the lantern
spotConfig.text: The crimson lantern catches. For a moment every pillar on the causeway flickers with it.

spotConfig.label: Look closer
spotConfig.text: A tiny ant peeks out at you.

spotConfig.label: Look below the words
spotConfig.text: Below the old words, a line was chiselled away. What is left of it points north, toward the Hub: a tunnel that was never written down.

spotConfig.label: Drop the decree into the brazier
spotConfig.text: The paper curls and blackens. For a moment the Samurai seal glows red in the coals. Then it is gone.

spotConfig.label: Walk into the passage
spotConfig.text: Between the stones of the rock garden a crack opens into the hill. Cold air, then darkness. The passage runs east under the hills, past roots and old Ronin handprints, until daylight again: grass, a palisade, Samurai lanterns. You are behind the watch posts.

hotspots.description:
Names, places, routes, joined by red string.

The string always ends at the same place: under the Hub.
The panel slides without a sound. Five blades, oiled and ready, none of them signed.

THE RONIN KEEP THE DOOR SHUT. THE DEBT IS PAID IN SILENCE.

Every tablet in this hall is a debt, owed or owing. When one is paid, its cord is cut and the tablet is burned in this flame.

One tablet is new. The ink still smells of soot:

THE HUB. FOR THE WARNING. UNPAID.

Eleven marks in a ring, one for every Rebel village, and the red hand across the seam.

Under the hand, cut deep: WE SEALED IT TOGETHER. OPEN IT ONLY TOGETHER.

The Watcher cuts the crimson rope that has crossed the door for a hundred years. The two great leaves grind apart a hand's width, then an arm's, then wide enough for an ant. Cold air rolls out, smelling of roots and old stone. The road under every village is open.

riddles.q: Two guards stand before two doors. One door leads to the Old Door; the other drops into the ravine. One guard always lies, the other always tells the truth, and you do not know which is which. You may ask one guard one question. What do you ask?
a: 'Which door would the other guard say is safe?', then take the other door
riddles.why: Both guards point at the deadly door: the liar twists the honest answer, the honest one repeats the lie. So take the other one.

riddles.q: Four Rebels must cross the broken causeway at night with one torch. It holds two at a time, and a pair walks at the slower one’s pace. They take 1, 2, 5 and 10 minutes. What is the shortest time for all four to cross?
riddles.why: 1 and 2 cross (2), 1 brings the torch back (1), 5 and 10 cross together (10), 2 brings it back (2), 1 and 2 cross (2): 17.

riddles.q: The Ronin dojo is always dark. What fills it from wall to wall, weighs nothing, and runs from a single candle?
riddles.why: Light one candle and the dark is gone. The Ronin learn to move in it anyway.

riddles.q: Two strangers are brought before the Watcher. The first says: "The other one is lying." The second says: "We are both lying." Who tells the truth?
riddles.why: If the second spoke truly, they would both be lying, the second too. So the second lies, and then the first must be the honest one.

riddles.q: I walk beside you all day, grow long at dusk, and vanish in the Ronin night. What am I?
riddles.why: A shadow needs light. In the Ronin village the moon is all there is.

riddleAnswer.text: Scratched into the stone under the bonsai's roots: a wave, and a banana.
Small, yes, but only a few summers old. Look for the tree the fortress was built around.
